findings.title: Retain the lower catch saddle to its base
findings.proof: Separate lower saddle starts at Z70; separate base ends at Z70. M3 mounting heads terminate at Z70 and retain the base only. Closure M2 screws span Z73..81 and dowels Z74.2..77.3, joining saddle halves only. No lower-saddle/base fastener or declared integral part exists. The whole guide can lift or slide off the anchored base.
findings.required: Provide an integral or explicitly fastened lower/base load path with accessible mounting heads. Owner is correcting as integral machined PEEK.

related_service_limit: Split Z75.5 misses bores centered Z73 and Z78 with radius2.15. It is a thread-through guide unless redesigned; do not claim an opening axial clamp.
